source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Present
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if present LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and Present LED observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; leaves the SAS/SATA-versus-NVMe conflict unresolved and proposes unvalidated raw BMC control.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; calls for transport resolution, stable identity, safe insertion and physical evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify a physical Present/power indicator for all drives in an approved backplane population, but the source conflicts on whether that population and signal path are SAS/SATA or NVMe.
original_method: Keep separate candidate procedures: insert SAS/SATA media into an HBA/RAID backplane and observe its Present indicator, or insert NVMe SSDs into an NVMe backplane and observe theirs. Both require transport-specific bay mapping and cannot be merged.
manual_activity: The eventual test requires physical insertion and visual observation, but the operator cannot safely select drives, carriers, bays or expected signal semantics until the transport conflict is resolved.
required_inputs: Present LED truth table for the selected backplane
Hot-plug or powered-off insertion and ESD method
safety_requirements: Do not insert any drive while its transport and compatible bay are ambiguous.
Exclude boot, mounted, protected, data-bearing and unknown drives.
Do not issue undocumented raw BMC commands or treat inventory as physical LED proof.
Do not initialize, format, mount or write drives.
No automatic alternate-transport/bay attempt after mismatch.
agent_execution_scope: Record the source conflict and maintain separate transport-specific evidence plans.
After owner resolution, validate the population and collect read-only enumeration/events.
Correlate operator media to stable drive/bay identity.
Do not claim insertion, LED state or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve SAS/SATA versus NVMe and approve the authoritative LED/population specification.
Perform safe insertion and visual evidence collection.
Assess each bay and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not executable: the raw bytes have no documented transport/bay mapping and `lsblk` cannot resolve the conflict or prove Present LED behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run no management write before resolution; afterward use only read-only transport-specific inventory with manual Present LED evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SAS/SATA naming, NVMe insertion procedure, Present criterion and 15/8-minute fields remain preserved as conflicting facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Once resolved, execute a per-bay serial/mapping matrix with synchronized insertion, physical Present LED media and controller/BMC/OS evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Selected SAS/SATA or NVMe backplane only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record selected controller/adapter/backplane/BMC firmware and tools.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Selected transport's platform LED and service specification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A generic raw response cannot identify the tested physical LED.

project_override_considerations: A documented project override may choose one transport without changing master source. It cannot claim the other transport or untested bays.
expected_evidence: Owner transport decision and all-bay population
Selected LED truth table and safe insertion plan
Per-bay operator insertion/Present media plus matching transport telemetry
Final health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Test Set and item begin with SAS/SATA, while the procedure explicitly inserts an NVMe SSD. The drive, bay, controller and LED semantics differ materially.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core hardware selection is unresolved, so execution cannot safely or meaningfully proceed. This is genuine semantic blocking, not ordinary missing configuration.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its unvalidated raw-command shortcut and unresolved transport assumption.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts the transport conflict and tightens the classification to BLOCKED pending owner choice.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves both source paths and avoids fabricating a universal Present-LED command.

review_improvement: Prevents insertion into the wrong bay technology and false acceptance from generic BMC output.
independent_technical_reasoning: Present LEDs may be driven by different backplane/controller paths for SAS/SATA and NVMe. Because the source does not identify which physical system is under test, even the manual core cannot be safely planned.
no_automatic_retry: No physical or management action is permitted until the transport conflict is resolved.
